originality.rationale: Theorem 5 of Freitas–Laugesen–Liddell (2007), in full material, is a strict restriction to orthogonal boxes and does not imply an inequality under shearing. The more recent comprehensive weighted-perimeters preprint treats existence and planar classes, not this finite-dimensional 3D sharp result. Actual semantic publication database and literature searches returned no dominating extension. Residual historical priority and exact dated-source release time remain uncertain.
